svg.title: Notifications in Slack and Microsoft Teams — SoftTrack web design mockup (#265)
svg.desc: Outbound webhooks send signed JSON, which neither Slack nor Teams accepts, so connecting one takes a small service in between. A channel destination takes the incoming webhook address the chat tool gives out, the events to post and a filter, and posts a message a person can read.
svg.text: Notifications in Slack and Microsoft Teams

svg.text: Done when a team admin can add a Slack or Teams channel with its incoming webhook address, the events to post and a filter; the message carries the key and title as a link, who
did what and what changed; the address is checked against private ranges, shown once and masked afterwards; deliveries are retried and listed; a test message is sent on saving;
and internal notes are never posted.
